about.title: Who am I?
about.name: My name is Artem, and I have been a developer for 4 years. I specialize in frontend development and also have solid skills in backend.
about.shortInfo: Programming began to fascinate me a long time ago, I found my first job in this direction when I was 16 years old. By the way, the basis of this site, from the code to the design, was made then too.
about.currentInfo: I'm currently in my third year at the Higher School of Economics. And I'm looking for a job, since you're here 😉
about.endInfo: Let's move on to the next section!
